## Overview

This hub collects **scholarly research and academic work** by **Sophal Chan**—including **four published outputs** on machine-learning detection of **knee osteoarthritis** from X-ray imagery, graduate research at **Prince of Songkla University**, and supervision of **Programming for Data Science** capstones at **ITC**.
